title: fix(voice-call): preserve Twilio greetings and resume listening after silence
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Twilio conversation calls without media streams lose their Say greeting when a second live TwiML update replaces it, then disconnect after roughly five seconds of silence following a reply.

Supersedes #158357, thanks @cestercian
Fixes #158262

## Result

Send Say followed by Gather in one conversation update. Gather waits up to 120 seconds and redirects silence to the signed webhook, which renews listening without replaying the greeting or resetting the existing call-duration limit. Distinct callback identities preserve repeated silence callbacks, and explicit conversation turns retain their token. Signature verification is unchanged.

#191264 owns the notification tail; this replacement leaves it alone. Direct-speech TwiML and streaming behavior are preserved.

The shared Gather builder removes duplicate rendering. Production remains +65/-24 (net +41) because webhook renewal and explicit-turn correlation require new flow code. Tests are +312/-2 (net +310); the exact 310-line allocation covers the signed-webhook boundary regression and independent TwiML contracts.

## Proof

- **Red before the fix:** [run 41956885174, job 127014449625](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41956885174/job/127014449625), test-only head `893166e08e4d0237d6fce0bf9ee8056bafad8d56`. Node and Bun fail the intended greeting-count and Gather-timeout assertions. Direct-speech preservation passes.
- **Current-head proof:** [CI run 42004275034](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/42004275034) succeeds at `92c7f88a8e2bc0fa52c7e0515c719baeb2f6d193`. [Job 127167828896](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/42004275034/job/127167828896) passes the 35-file/404-test voice-call groups on the current Bun plan, including all four signed-webhook scenarios and provider/manager/notify/streaming consumers. Production/test types, lint, source contracts, ratchet and repaired Windows partition shard pass. [Darwin tooling run 42004275087](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/42004275087/job/127166975069) also succeeds. All attached Actions jobs were verified success/skipped before native submission.
- **Synthetic transport:** the actual HTTP handler, HMAC verifier, call manager, isolated state store and Twilio XML generation process the fixture requests. Only external carrier HTTP and model inference are intercepted; no listener, real credentials, Team state or network request is used. Assertions cover inbound/outbound greetings, repeated silence, the next reply, invalid signatures, explicit-turn correlation and terminal cleanup.
- **Independent Codex autoreview:** scoped-clean, P0–P3, full final diff from `5389c2a105cfa1d96b7c65691f5341abb3d2aab8` to the exact head above, with intact webhook/signature/replay/manager/provider context. No code or tests executed by the reviewer.
- **Code-scanning limitation:** the separate aggregate CodeQL comparison is neutral because 18 main configurations were not found for comparison. Planned CodeQL and security-review Actions complete successfully; this does not claim complete aggregate scanning coverage.

**Live-Twilio gap:** no actual carrier call, audio playback observation, carrier timeout trace or real model response has been verified. Synthetic signed-webhook proof establishes the in-process call flow, not live carrier timing. Local test runs were not used because their compiled-worker preparation exceeds this production host's allowance.
